apps.author: ARMSX2
apps.name: ARM SX2
apps.changeLog: # ARMSX2 2.8.3 What's new: ## MaliSX2 for Mali GPUs MaliSX2 is a Vulkan driver for Mali GPUs that @bmdhacks built for ARMSX2. In 2.8.2 it was offered only on the Mali-G615 and G715, under its old name, libmali. Now it also covers the Mali-G57, G68, G77 and G78 (including the G78AE), which a lot of handhelds use, the Anbernic RG 476H among them. What it does for a game: on @DIB1998 Mali G57, Ace Combat 4 and Ace Combat 5 were unplayable on the stock driver. With ARMSX2's driver MaliSX2 0.1.4 both run at full speed, as well as many other games that previously did not. On those GPUs: - The GPU driver list (Renderer settings, or the in-game menu) offers MaliSX2 to download. - Auto now picks Vulkan. - If Vulkan ends up on Arm's driver instead, a notice tells you to get MaliSX2. - With MaliSX2 loaded, several Mali workarounds are switched off, since it doesn't need them. MaliSX2 needs a fairly recent Mali kernel driver. On an older one it can't load, and the game runs on Arm's driver instead. done by @bmdhacks ## New **Both controllers rumble.** If you set two controllers to the same player (say your handheld's own controls and a controller for the TV), both rumble now, not just the one you used last. Don't want one of them to? Set that controller's Rumble to Off in Controls > Player & Rumble. done by @jpolo1224 **Close Game asks first (#814).** The Close Game and Close Game & Quit hotkeys now pause the game and ask before closing, with Cancel already selected. Press B or Back to keep playing. Asked for by @anubys-droid. done by @jpolo1224 **See what the game actually runs (#813).** In a game's settings, a value the game database sets now shows in purple with a diamond, and anything changed from its default shows in red with a circle. Where the database sets a value, the row shows that value, since it's what the game runs. Pick a different one to override it, or pick the database's own value to hand it back. done by @bmdhacks **Leave a folder's subfolders out.** Each game folder in Setup now has an "Include subfolders" switch. Turn it off and only the games directly in that folder show up, so a folder of other things inside it, like another console's games, stays out of your library. done by @jpolo1224 **Soul Calibur II Conquest mode.** The Conquest card that comes with the app is now already cleared, so Conquest mode works without a trip to the test menu. If you got the old card in 2.8.2 and the game never wrote to it, it's swapped for the cleared one automatically. And if you do want to start over, DATA CLEAR > ALL CLEAR in the test menu now saves properly instead of saving over and over forever. done by @jpolo1224 and requested by @israpps ## Fixed **Battery drain in the background (#825, #817).** With a game paused and the app in the background, the device never got to sleep. One Retroid Pocket 6 went from 76% to 0% overnight. The app kept its audio running so Resume would be instant, and that kept Android's audio system awake. Now, while the app is out of sight, it lets go of the audio, the library background stops drawing, Discord and gyro aiming go quiet, and the paused game mostly sleeps. Resume is still instant when you come back. done by @jpolo1224 **Arcade buttons pressing twice.** In arcade games, a button press also went to the PS2 controller port, which a real cabinet doesn't have. Menus like Soul Calibur II's test menu would open and close again in one press. fixed by @jpolo1224 **Swapping an arcade key.** Replacing the security key file next to an arcade game with a different one now takes effect. The app used to keep booting its first copy until you deleted it by hand. fixed by @jpolo1224 **Broken lines on Vulkan.** On Vulkan drivers without one particular feature, Qualcomm's stock Adreno driver among them, lines came out the wrong width and direction: Sly's outlines, the edges of Yu-Gi-Oh!'s selection boxes, Burnout 3's power lines. done by @bmdhacks **Gran Turismo 4 frame drops (#797).** GT4 dropped frames on Mali and Adreno at night and in the bumper and cockpit views, because the game kept waiting on the GPU to read back a brightness value. It now reads it without waiting, which should stop those drops. done by @bmdhacks, based on a PR by @Richpol99 **Gran Turismo 4 PAL patches (#798).** New patches for trigger sensitivity, 480p without interlacing, and the camera. done by @Richpol99 **Per-game GPU drivers (#807).** Changing the Graphics API or deleting a driver no longer locks a game to the system driver. The Renderer tab's Reset now also clears the Graphics API, GPU driver and ANGLE, and ANGLE can be turned on for a single game. A game whose driver you deleted now uses your global driver. done by @siramok and @bmdhacks **Settings saving (#786).** A settings save could clash with the emulator reading the same settings at that moment, and a change could be lost. done by @luistiagos **Closing a game.** Fixed a rare freeze when closing a game, where the app waited forever on an emulator thread that had already stopped. done by @bmdhacks **Graphics dumps.** A GS dump is now a single .gs.zip holding the dump, a driver report and a screenshot, so a graphics bug report is one file to attach. done by @bmdhacks

apps.author: azahar-emu
apps.name: Azahar
apps.changeLog:
This a minor release for the 2126 branch which primarily addresses a reported security advisory.
It also includes several newly backported improvements and fixes from the master branch.

Users are advised to update as soon as is convenient.

---

# Azahar 2126.2 Changelog

# All

- Addressed an oversight which allowed specially-crafted CIA files to execute arbitrary code in the host environment when locally installed by a user. | @PabloMK7 #2648 
  - Addresses the following GHSA report: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/security/advisories/GHSA-h74v-5mw8-qg8r
- Fixed an issue where the xBRZ texture filter would be applied incorrectly when using the Vulkan renderer, resulting in an incorrect appearance. | @OpenSauce04 #2647 
- Handling of large HTTP downloads within emulated 3DS applications has been improved, improving memory efficiency and stability. | @PabloMK7 #2515 
   - Fixes downloading large games from the eShop. 
- Added a new 3GX loader flag `allow_homebrew_load`, which allows loading 3GX plugins for homebrew apps if the plugin supports it. | @PabloMK7 #2649

# Desktop

- Various improvements to GDB and RPC servers, fixing certain issues and improving functionality. | @PabloMK7 #2631, #2640, #2633
  - For additional info, see individual PR descriptions.
  - Script developers will need to update the RPC client as this is a breaking change. 

# Android

- Fixed a crash which could occur if the `gpu_drivers` directory contained a subdirectory. | @ygordreyer #2592

# Technical

- Creating a copy of the kernel shared and config pages using svcMapProcessMemoryEx is now possible.
  - This is a technical accuracy change. Little to no end-user impact.

apps.changeLog:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/2029e30dcc1ba1ecb8d73313f18b429b40e6044c7785c52af08b948ef94b3ddf)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people
